limitations: OS-level provider sandboxing remains outside W71-S02.

findings.summary: The canonical gate still needs fail-hard process supervision, complete coverage, and supported-version determinism.
limitations: Performance benchmarking is isolated from correctness acceptance until W71-S03.

findings.summary: Prepared Task data and the route executed by Start are not yet one versioned, durable contract.
limitations: Existing W70 presentation evidence remains valid only at its documented fixture scope.

findings.summary: Intent, run, and Task transitions need atomic durable state and restart-safe ownership.
limitations: Distributed hosted coordination remains outside the local W71 runtime boundary.

findings.summary: Delivery, release, route, and scope validation still require a single fail-closed grammar and evidence boundary.
limitations: No real upstream write is permitted as part of remediation evidence.

findings.summary: W71-S07/S10 expose the server-owned Task and provision/integration boundaries; one installed Prepare-to-Start-to-Work proof remains for W71-S14.
limitations: W70 browser fixtures do not constitute integrated control-plane proof.

findings.summary: W71-S08 now supplies durable Ask AOR, recovery, review, and completion transitions; installed public control-plane qualification remains for W71-S14.
limitations: Historical deterministic lifecycle evidence is retained as historical or fixture evidence only.

findings.summary: W71-S09 hardens multirepo scope locking and isolated measured integration; W71-S10 now exposes the public provision-to-integration producer path, while installed closure remains for W71-S14.
limitations: Constructed W62 proof remains useful diagnostic evidence but is not installed public proof.

findings.summary: W71-S11 resolves qualification bytes through the shared evidence owner, binds current identity and freshness, and proves validator-owned adversarial coverage; paid provider qualification remains a separate release gate.
limitations: Paid provider qualification remains outside deterministic W71 development acceptance.

findings.summary: Quality and maintainability checks do not yet enforce complete behavior coverage and bounded critical hotspots.
limitations: Behavior-preserving hotspot decomposition follows the deterministic gate restoration.

findings.summary: Current story and readiness claims must distinguish baseline, fixture, integrated-local, and live-provider evidence.
limitations: W59 historical closure remains immutable and is not rewritten by W71.

findings.summary: The merged Command Desk UI and runtime still need one installed real-control-plane proof and immutable qualification freeze.
limitations: The sibling UI branch is an immutable handoff until its own review and merge; it is not current main evidence.
